description: Hazard Resilient Pipeline Research Panel (HRPRP) Report is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Craig Davis, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This report presents a process and matrix for utilizing buried hazard resilient pipelines. They were developed by a group of researchers from the USA and Japan who worked to improve the understanding of hazard impacts on buried water pipelines. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-1yex-b192. Keywords: pipelines, hazards, resilience, infrastructure, multihazards. Published 2024-02-23. Facility named: Center for Smart Infrastructure, Center for Infrastructure, Energy, and Space Testing. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
